system.health.doctor-summary.label: Last checkup
system.health.doctor-summary.help: A snapshot of the last check, not a live promise.
system.health.doctor-summary.why: Shown in the summary at the top of Doctor.

system.health.run-doctor.label: Check everything
system.health.run-doctor.help: Checks every group once; nothing is changed or installed.

system.health.auto-run.label: Check the setup automatically
system.health.auto-run.help: Catches problems before they interrupt your work.

system.health.check-frequency.label: How often
system.health.check-frequency.help: You can always check by hand.

hints.Only when I ask: The same as turning automatic checks off.
hints.Never: Also skips the check at startup.

system.health.check-scope.label: What is checked
system.health.check-scope.help: Leaving areas out is faster but can hide problems.

system.health.readiness-badges.label: Show status labels around the app
system.health.readiness-badges.help: Ready, Needs setup or Needs attention at a glance.

system.health.degraded-visibility.label: Warn about half-working connections
system.health.degraded-visibility.help: Instead of hiding them until they fail.

system.health.remediation-links.label: Show fix-it links
system.health.remediation-links.help: Jump from a problem to the setting that solves it.

system.health.platform-diagnostics.label: Collect support details
system.health.platform-diagnostics.help: Computer and install details, with secrets removed.
